city_full: Port Authority of the City of Bloomington

hero.headline: Bloomington is ready to promote itself. Let’s make its story *clear.*
hero.lead: Your economic development strategic plan calls for a campaign that promotes Bloomington as a place to work and do business, anchored by a professional video built for business recruitment and talent attraction. Hallpass can help turn that ambition into a story people see, remember, and act on.

photo.alt: A large evening crowd on the lawn at the Normandale Lake Bandshell during Summer Fete

concepts.headline: Make Bloomington’s advantages *visible.*
concepts.lead: A connected editorial system, not one-off posts, could give site selectors, employers, early-career professionals, and the commuters who already work here multiple ways into the same Bloomington story.

plan.quote: Clearly articulating the Bloomington story and sharing it *consistently across platforms and audiences* will help amplify the efforts of multiple partners.
plan.quote_source: Port Authority of the City of Bloomington Economic Development Strategic Plan, adopted February 2025, p. 3
plan.outside_help_heading: The plan already calls for video.
plan.outside_help_quote: Action 8.1.2 calls for a marketing campaign focused on business and talent attraction, including “a professional promotional video highlighting innovation and quality of place in Bloomington that can be used for business recruitment and talent attraction” (p. 25).

pov.people_line: We start with people: the manufacturer that chose to grow here, the intern who found a career through Bloom in Bloomington, the local owner who pitched at Hatch and expanded.
